'''Hyomare''' was the seventh [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Bestine system/Legends|Bestine system]]<ref name="TEA" /> located in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAWGG" /> Hyomare was one of the three [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giants]] in the star system and had ten [[Moon/Legends|moons]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
All of the [[Bestine system/Legends|Bestine system]]'s planets were first mentioned in the [[2009]] sourcebook ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''.<ref name="TEA" />
